research_result.description: Klaviyo is a marketing automation platform for email and SMS that provides extensive REST APIs, client/server tracking, and official MCP server integrations for AI agents.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can get started for free and create test accounts to generate private API keys from their account Settings page. Tech partners building integrations can also authenticate using OAuth.

evidence.claim: Klaviyo supports API key, OAuth, and public key authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).

evidence.claim: Klaviyo provides a free self-serve path for developer access and API development.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Create apps and integrations using Klaviyo's API that help your business grow. Get started for free.

evidence.claim: Klaviyo uses a REST API following the JSON:API standard.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: I will then spend the rest of the article discussing JSON:API, the flavor of REST that Klaviyo adopted.

evidence.claim: Klaviyo chose not to adopt GraphQL.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Ultimately, we decided that taking on a GraphQL API without first having a solid foundation in REST was not a wise path for Klaviyo.

evidence.claim: Klaviyo provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Klaviyo Model Context Protocol (MCP) server seamlessly integrates with Klaviyo’s APIs, enabling AI clients to interact with your Klaviyo data.
